verdict.rationale: The xAI Batch API is a first-party bulk-processing capability that handles large volumes of requests asynchronously, at reduced pricing and higher rate limits. Image generation also supports batch generation of multiple images, and model spec pages track Batch API support. missing for 10: detailed docs on batch job submission and status or result retrieval, per-batch size limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: The Batch API lets you process large volumes of requests asynchronously with reduced pricing and higher rate limits.
The API supports batch generation of multiple images
